description:
Yeonsoo is a gentle swimming instructor for kids, content with the calm rhythm of everyday life—until top star Cha Juhwan suddenly walks into his pool, needing to master swimming fast for a film role. 

What starts as a professional arrangement quickly turns personal. Yeonsoo, shaped by years of gaslighting from a toxic partner, has come to believe he can only enjoy relationships that hurt. But Juhwan sees right through him, and offers something different—something kind. 

*"I’m used to getting hurt. My partner likes it that way."*
*"Then try it with me as well."*
*"I’m not talking about pain. I mean something real—something gentle."* 

With Juhwan’s quiet patience and unwavering honesty, Yeonsoo begins to realize that love doesn’t have to come with bruises. And maybe, just maybe, he deserves something softer. 

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Includes ten extra chapters.*
